name: Potions & Emotions
source:
Accompany Thalia--an aspiring alchemist and wannabe super villain--who hell-bent on taking over the entire planet. She travels to a magical forest in order to collect raw materials for her alchemy projects, and stumbles upon a sleepy town hidden within. After seeing this and recognizing the potency of the magic surrounding this town, she decides to start small and set up her secret lair within its walls by taking over as the town’s next mayor.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2512250/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
与塔莉娅结伴同行吧——这位雄心勃勃的炼金术士一心想当超级大反派，铁了心要统治整个星球。为了搜集炼金研究所需的原材料，她动身前往一片魔法森林，却在林间深处意外撞见了一座宁静慵懒的小镇。见识到此地萦绕的强大魔力后，她决定先从小目标做起：拿下小镇下一任镇长的宝座，在镇墙之内建起自己的秘密老巢。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2512250/]Steam[/url]]
